subject.title: Feature request: MEMORY.md size warning/limit enforcement

question: Should OpenClaw add core Control UI save-time `MEMORY.md` budget enforcement and an archive workflow, or limit this issue to existing diagnostics plus the broader bounded-memory design?
rationale: Current main already warns and diagnoses truncation, but the remaining request changes the workspace-file editing UX and memory lifecycle rather than repairing a single broken code path.

options.title: Define a narrow core UX contract
options.body: Add a Control UI budget display and explicit save-time warning/blocking for bootstrap files, while leaving auto-archive to a separate memory design.

options.title: Fold into bounded memory work
options.body: Track hard limits and archive behavior in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/42877 and treat this issue as diagnostics-only once maintainers confirm that direction.

options.title: Review the diagnostics PR only
options.body: Use the open fork PR for additional `/status` or edit-error diagnostics if desired, but keep UI save enforcement out of that branch unless maintainers expand its scope.

recommendation.title: Define a narrow core UX contract
recommendation.body: Add a Control UI budget display and explicit save-time warning/blocking for bootstrap files, while leaving auto-archive to a separate memory design.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is the merged bootstrap warning unification and Agents dashboard/file API work that this decision would extend.
